types.name: Document
types.docstring: An HTML body with the facts the site needs from it.
types.signature: pub(all) struct Document { html : String title : String? summary : String headings : Array[Heading] ids : Array[String] text : String }

types.name: FieldValue
FrontMatter
types.docstring:
Front matter and the rest of a source file. `body_line` is the 1-based line
 where the body starts in the source file.

types.name: Heading
LayersPass
types.docstring: The result of the layer-stack pass over one page.

values.name: analyse_html
values.docstring:
Add missing IDs to headings, preserve explicit IDs and attributes, then
 collect the title (first `h1`), summary (first paragraph), headings, ids and text.

values.name: check_moonbit_fences
values.docstring:
Check the MoonBit fences of a Markdown source that `moon test` does not compile: each fence whose
 language is `moonbit` or `mbt` must have the word `notest` after the language. `first_line` is the
 line number of the first line of `source` in the file.
values.signature: fn check_moonbit_fences(file : String, source : String, first_line? : Int) -> Array[@moonrockz/telescope/model.Problem]

values.name: escape
values.docstring: Escape text for an HTML text node or a double-quoted attribute value.

values.name: ids_in
values.docstring: Every quoted ID attribute in document order.

values.name: inline_text
values.docstring: The text of inline HTML, such as a heading: like `plain_text`, but a tag adds no space, so `A (b)` is `A (b)`.

values.name: map_urls
values.docstring:
Apply `f` to every `href` and `src` attribute value, double- or single-quoted. `f` receives the URL with
 entities decoded, and its result is escaped again.
values.signature: fn map_urls(html : String, f : (String) -> String) -> String

values.name: parse_front_matter
values.docstring:
Split `source` into front matter and body. Markdown front matter is a block
 between two `---` lines at the top. HTML front matter is the same block inside
 a leading `<!-- --- ... --- -->` comment. A file without the block has no fields.
values.signature: fn parse_front_matter(file : String, source : String) -> FrontMatter raise @moonrockz/telescope/model.Invalid

values.name: plain_text
values.docstring: The text of an HTML fragment: tags removed, entities decoded, white space collapsed.

values.name: render_callouts
values.docstring:
Turn each block quote whose first line is `[!NOTE]`, `[!TIP]`, `[!IMPORTANT]`, `[!WARNING]` or
 `[!CAUTION]` into `aside.callout.<kind>` with a label. Other block quotes stay as they are.

values.name: render_layers
values.docstring:
Replace each `layers` code block with `figure.layer-stack`: an ordered list with one layer for each
 non-empty `name | detail` line, the first line at the top. A line without `|` gives a problem.

values.name: slug
values.docstring:
A heading anchor: ASCII letters and digits are kept (lower case), white space,
 `-` and `_` become one `-`, and every other character is removed.

values.name: unescape
values.docstring:
Undo the entity escapes that cmark writes in text and code. `&` is last, so
 `&lt;` becomes `<` and not `<`.
